1.0: I've already heard from Sharyl, the Prince of Whales. Can you give me the Magic Flask that you received from the Prince?

yes.0: It takes a little time to collect the Vigor of the Sea. Can you wait a minute?

npc.0: You can find Muse at the Aquarium. Please get the Vigor of the Sea for me. Please....

lost.0: What? You broke the Magic Flask? You'll really need to be careful with it, because it's made out of glass. I'll give you another one, so place fill up the flask with the Vigor of the Sea and bring it back to me.

0.0: Ah hello there! You must be the one that experienced the power of the Shining Stone before. Doesn't it seem like it's a bit darker here these days? It's that the ones that light up The Nautilus, the Water Fireflies, are getting weaker by the day.\r\n#L0##bWater Firefly?#k#l
0.1: Yes. Water Fireflies are these mysterious creatures that emit bright lights by consuming the Vigor of the Sea deep in the ocean. Once The Nautilus reached Victoria Island, they have never had a chance to go back under the deep sea, so their lighting has dimmed little by little. If you have some time to spare, can you get us some Vigors of the Sea for the sake of Kyrin and the fireflies?

yes.0: You can get the Vigor of the Sea from #bOlaf of Lith Harbor#k. Fill this Magic Flask with #bthe Vigor of the Sea#k.

no.0: Are you busy? Oh no... What will we do?

QuestInfo.name: Sea Firefly 1
QuestInfo.0: Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, hanging out on the lower deck of The Nautilus, says he's got another problem. Let me see what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Sharyl, the Prince of Whales tells me some mystical story about a Sea Firefly. I guess there are many other mystical objects on The Nautilus besides the Shining Stone? Anyway, according to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, the mystical Sea Firefly's powers are diminishing, which is making him worried. I'd better help Sharyl, the Prince of Whales by going to the #bOlaf#k in #bLith Harbor#k to fill the magic flask with some  #bVigor of the Sea#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went to see the Olaf, who filled the Magic Flask with the Vigor of the Sea.
